KXMARMAD3D.quote: If any player records a triple-double in the men's college basketball tournament
KXMARMAD3D.reason: YES if any player in the whole 2026 men's tournament (First Four included) gets 10+ in three of points/rebounds/assists/blocks/steals. Actor is the entire field over ~67 games, a tail event aggregated across players and bracket survival, not a named player's single-game prop.

KXMARMADCONFWIN.quote: If any team from the SEC is the 2025-26 Division 1 Men's College Basketball National Champion
KXMARMADCONFWIN.reason: YES if the 2025-26 D1 men's national champion is any team from the named conference (SEC). Sum of member teams' title probabilities from the NCAA bracket, the futures_champion mechanism; conference only groups the outcome, it is not a conference title.

KXMARMADPTS.quote: If any player records 50+ points in a game within the men's college basketball tournament
KXMARMADPTS.reason: YES if any player scores 50+ in a single game anywhere in the 2026 men's tournament (First Four included). Extreme right tail of per-game scoring, maximised over all players and games played; no named player, so player_points/player_props do not generate it.

KXMARMADSEEDDIF.quote: the greatest seeding disadvantage overcome by any winner in the full tournament
KXMARMADSEEDDIF.reason: Resolves on the maximum seed-number gap of any upset win across the full 2026 bracket (e.g. 12 over 5 = 7), threshold 9+. Generated by simulating every bracket game with seeds as fixed labels, i.e. seed/advancement outcomes of futures_seed_other, not one team's title.

KXMARMADSEEDROUND.quote: the number of teams that are seeded #1 qualifying for the Round of 16
KXMARMADSEEDROUND.reason: Counts how many of the four #1 seeds reach the Round of 16 (exactly N buckets). Outcome is the joint round-reached result of the seed-1 teams across four regions, a seed-line advancement outcome that futures_seed_other's bracket stages produce.

KXMARMADSEEDSUM.quote: the sum of the official seeds of the teams in the semifinals
KXMARMADSEEDSUM.reason: Rules confirm the sum of official seeds of the four Final Four (semifinal) teams falling in a range (9-10 here). Joint round-reached outcome measured in seed units across four regions; not a conference outcome as the ledger had it. Prior title-based filing now verified.

KXMARMADSEEDWIN.quote: the number of teams that are seeded #16 achieving a win in the Round of 64
KXMARMADSEEDWIN.reason: Rules confirm it counts #16 seeds winning a Round-of-64 game (at least 1 here); First Four wins are not Round-of-64 wins. Seed-line advancement outcome driven by 1-vs-16 game probabilities, so futures_seed_other, not futures_conference as the ledger filed it.

KXMARMADUPSET.quote: the number of teams achieving an upset (based on seeding) in the Round of 8
KXMARMADUPSET.reason: Counts Elite Eight (Round of 8) games won by the higher numerical seed, exact count. Depends on which seeds survive to that round and the regional-final win probabilities, a seed-labelled bracket advancement aggregate covered by futures_seed_other.

KXNCAAMB1HWINNER.quote: If both teams score the same amount of points during the half, all team strikes resolve to No and the Tie strike resolves to Yes
KXNCAAMB1HWINNER.reason: Three-way first-half winner (team A, team B, Tie) on points scored in the first half of regulation only; tie is its own strike. Exactly the first_half archetype's half-winner mechanism; postponement keeps the market open until the rescheduled game.

KXNCAAMB2ML.quote: Michigan is the 2025-26 Division 1 Men's College Basketball National Champion and UCLA is the 2025-26 Division 1 Women's College Basketball National Champion
KXNCAAMB2ML.reason: Parlay: YES only if the named men's team wins the D1 men's title AND the named women's team wins the D1 women's title. Men's leg is futures_champion; the women's tournament leg is a separate competition with no CBB (men's) inputs, so in scope with low confidence.

KXNCAAMBACHAMP.quote: If Coastal Carolina wins the College Baseball Championship
KXNCAAMBACHAMP.reason: Rules confirm the series settles on the College Baseball Championship (Men's College World Series) winner, e.g. Coastal Carolina; baseball, not basketball, despite the NCAAMB ticker prefix and the ledger's futures_champion filing.

KXNCAAMBCBC.quote: is the 2025-26 Division 1 Men's College Basketball Crown tournament winner
KXNCAAMBCBC.reason: Winner of the College Basketball Crown, a multi-round postseason tournament for teams outside the NCAA field. Bracket-survival title outcome (futures_champion's 'related title' mechanism), not a single-game side as the ledger filed it; field differs from the NCAA bracket.

KXNCAAMBCOTY.quote: wins Naismith Men's College Coach of the Year in the 2025-26 season
KXNCAAMBCOTY.reason: Resolves on the Naismith Men's College Coach of the Year winner, a voted individual award driven by team overperformance versus expectation and narrative; matches polls_and_awards' individual-award target.

KXNCAAMBFIRST10.quote: is the first to reach 10 points in the UConn vs Michigan men's college basketball game
KXNCAAMBFIRST10.reason: Rules confirm the racing entity is a team: the named team is first to reach 10 points in the game. First-passage of early scoring, unrelated to player points (ledger). Tie/void handling not stated in the rules text.

KXNCAAMBFIRST25.quote: is the first to reach 25 points in the UConn vs Michigan men's college basketball game
KXNCAAMBFIRST25.reason: Team-level first-passage to 25 points in the game, confirmed by rules text; depends on scoring rate and run structure through roughly the first half, not on player points as the ledger filed it.

KXNCAAMBFIRST50.quote: is the first to reach 50 points in the UConn vs Michigan men's college basketball game
KXNCAAMBFIRST50.reason: Team-level first-passage to 50 points, confirmed by rules text; can extend late into the game so it converges toward the moneyline but remains a first-passage event. Rules are silent on neither team reaching 50.

KXNCAAMBIG12.quote: wins the Men's Big 12 Basketball Tournament
KXNCAAMBIG12.reason: Resolves on the winner of the Men's Big 12 conference tournament (e.g. Colorado). A conference-tournament futures outcome, exactly the futures_conference target; bracket survival within the conference field.

KXNCAAMBMOP.quote: wins Most Outstanding Player in the 2026 Men's College Basketball Tournament
KXNCAAMBMOP.reason: Resolves on the NCAA tournament Most Outstanding Player, a media-selected individual award dominated by Final Four performance on the champion; an award winner, so polls_and_awards.

KXNCAAMBNAISMITH.quote: wins the 2025-26 Men's College Basketball Naismith Player of the Year
KXNCAAMBNAISMITH.reason: Resolves on the Naismith Men's Player of the Year, a voted season-long individual award (stats, team success, narrative); fits the polls_and_awards individual-award target.

KXNCAAMBTEAMMOSTPTS.quote: scores the most points out of any team in the Semifinals
KXNCAAMBTEAMMOSTPTS.reason: YES if the named team scores the most points of the four semifinal teams; ties pay $1/N. Generated by each team's single-game points distribution (pace, efficiency, OT) compared across two games, so team_total's mechanism applies, with a cross-game max comparison.

tournament_player_milestone.label: Any-player tournament milestone (triple-double, 50-point game)
tournament_player_milestone.target: Whether any player in the whole NCAA men's tournament reaches a single-game stat milestone (triple-double, 50+ points)
tournament_player_milestone.why_distinct: Actor is the entire field: a rare single-game tail event maximised over all players and all games, weighted by how many games each team survives. Player prop archetypes model one named player in one game.

out_of_scope_categories.other_sport_college_baseball: College baseball championship series; a different sport (baseball) than men's college basketball, no basketball inputs apply.
